bullets: Summary: Implemented cutting-edge AI/ML, IoT automation, and backend solutions across diverse domains including education, healthcare, and enterprise systems. Specialized in building scalable platforms, integrating LLM-powered applications, and deploying production-ready solutions on AWS and Streamlit Cloud to drive automation, efficiency, and user engagement.

EnvironmentsByLE: Engineered an advanced IoT automation ecosystem for enterprise environments. Built features like room booking, natural language control for IoT devices (lights, doors), real-time sensor data gathering using SQL agents, and custom API integrations. Integrated RAG based querying for domain specific knowledge and real time web search. Deployed on AWS with scalable architecture, enabling reliable and secure automation for organizations.

ChippewaValleyUniversity: Designed and developed an AI-powered education platform enabling students and faculty to streamline study material creation and assessments. Teachers could generate exam Q&A sets, while students could upload documents and receive AI-generated summaries, questions, PPTs, PDFs, and real-time assessments. Delivered a robust backend and AI integration that enhanced student learning outcomes and academic workflows. .

MedicalTriage&AppointmentSystem: Built an AI driven triage and appointment scheduling platform integrated with real time hospital data and emergency APIs. Enabled patients to get instant AI guided assessments and book appointments efficiently, reducing emergency response time and improving patient management.
WoundDetection(ComputerVision–YOLO): Developed a wound severity detection model using YOLO to classify and assess wound conditions, enabling faster and more accurate medical triage support.

AI-PoweredCollegeRecommendationSystem: Implemented an NLP and ML based recommendation engine t o suggest top colleges based on student preferences (infrastructure, faculty, fees, placement, etc.). Integrated into a Django based web platform with an intuitive user interface for real time personalized recommendations.
Chatbot App – aibiplab.streamlit.app: Built an interactive LLM powered chatbot using LangChain and deployed on Streamlit Cloud.
Human Attribution Detection – beanai.streamlit.app: Developed an AI system leveraging Gemini to classify human attribution with real time inference and hosted it on Streamlit Cloud.
